dedupe_keys.name: bev digitales landschaftsmodell dlm austria wide vector landscape model with transport structures and buildings layers

description: The Digitales Landschaftsmodell (DLM) of the Bundesamt für Eich- und Vermessungswesen (BEV) is Austria's national topographic vector model, published as open government data in separate object areas. Contents: the DLM Verkehr (transport) area holds all roads, all railways and cable cars and lifts, plus georeferenced points of interest for rail, air and water transport, transport structures and facilities for communication and supply; further areas cover Bauten (buildings), Bauwerke (structures such as bridges, dams and masts), Gewässer (water bodies), Gebietsnutzung (land use) and Namen (names). Coverage: the whole of Austria, captured at high positional accuracy; releases are dated snapshots (Stichtag), the latest listed on data.gv.at being 25 January 2023, with earlier snapshots from October 2021, April 2022 and October 2022. Format and access: GeoPackage and Shapefile downloads from data.bev.gv.at, catalogued on data.gv.at and in the BEV GeoNetwork catalogue. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the snapshots are not continuously updated, the attribute model is documented in BEV's product description, not in the download, and supply lines are captured as points of interest, not as a network. Simulation uses: national road and rail network geometry and structures for hazard exposure mapping, network models and building exposure. Related records: the GIP.at transport graph (data-austria-gip-intermodal-transport-graph) is the routable road network, while the DLM gives the cartographic transport geometry.
